feedback_summary: The script correctly identifies all five energy sources and highlights the highest and lowest contributors. However, it incorporates external moral judgment and policy recommendations in the conclusion, invoking the Graph/Chart standalone cap (maximum 6). Language mechanics are compromised by frequent spelling slips and fragmented syntax, placing the response at the base of Band 3 with 6 marks.
